content: Fernwood Trail Club is a weekend hiking group I organize. We meet on Saturdays at 8am at the Cedar Gap trailhead.
Priya is the treasurer of the Fernwood Trail Club. Monthly dues are $10 per member.
Cedar Gap trailhead has limited parking, about 15 cars, so Fernwood hikers should carpool.
Decision: Fernwood Trail Club group hikes are capped at 12 people to protect the trail and keep the group safe.
Fernwood Trail Club hikes are capped at 12 hikers.
I prefer sending Fernwood Trail Club announcements as short text messages, not long emails.
Fernwood Trail Club trail cleanup is next Saturday at the Cedar Gap trailhead, 9am, bring gloves.
Correction: the Fernwood Trail Club now meets at 7am instead of 8am, because summer afternoons are too hot.
Update: the Fernwood trail cleanup moved to the following weekend because the original date clashes with the county fair.
